profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Engineering professional working to deliver real world demonstrations of the newest technologies. Years of experience in DSP and Telecom systems, extensive experience in audio processing dealing with Audio Codecs (lossless and lossy), vocoders, and echo cancellation/suppression algorithms.  Experience in system design and in leading teams working on advanced systems like systems.  Experience in prototyping demonstrations of new technologies quickly.

Seeking to manage and contribute to technological development, integration, and delivery of dynamic experiences in the audio/video space.  Multidisciplinary learner with familiarity with spatial audio, deep learning, Agile development, and event logistics.

positions.title: Senior Audio Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built a reference-based Perceptual Audio Quality Metric. Worked on cross-platform audio processing frameworks and plugin development for the said framework. Managed cross-functional relationships in order to identify, prioritize, and drive the development of capabilities to support customer use cases resulting in the delivery of a system that allowed Sound Engineers to have full control over mastering within an in-house solution.
A smattering of Android/PHP/Buck along with the main focus on c++ library code for deployment in both servers and embedded devices.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Audio Processing · Digital Audio · Project Management

positions.title: Senior Staff Engineer for Innovation Prototyping
positions.description:
Working with the RPG (Rapid Prototyping Group), our focus is to demonstrate new experiences quickly for evaluation and iteration to feed the product pipeline.  We turn ideas into demos, then demos into defined projects, so that projects can become products.

I'm proud to have worked on the ideas which became Dolby's Technology in games like Blizzard's Overwatch and EA's Battlefront.  I'm excited to play in the VR space and work on emergent technologies in Deep Learning.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Engineer for Internal R&D Project
Lead Engineer for development of CID system contracted by CERDEC
Aided with project planning for said contract.
Performed Systems Engineering and System Design Documentation for advanced CID system.
Performed software implementation of designs in a team environment (task assignments and tracking).
Programmed modifications in SRW on an SCA compliant CORBA based waveform development platform.

positions.title: Senior DSP Software Engineer
positions.description:
Audio:
Echo Cancellation software (in assembly).  Add audio features (ie. full duplex in call recording).
Designed and delivered Automated Audio Shaping Filter Designer using MATLAB for use by audio team.
Integrated a new low bit rate vocoder to the DSP.

General:
Debug software issues and emergent customer complaints across group disciplines.  Patching code on ROM's.
Design of functional integration scheme of third party chip solution.  Expand inter-chip communication protocols.  
Integration of a new compiler into build process.  Configuration management of releases of DSP software.
Travel to various sites to trace down connectivity issues across disciplines.

Lead Activities:
Liaison to various teams locally and abroad (India).  Trained and coordinated development efforts with teams abroad.
DSP Team representative during shipment of multiple products.
Tracked issues and assigned resources as needed to guarantee shipping of products.
